title: CohomologyFiniteExtension
statement: Let X be a scheme, R a Noetherian commutative ring, and sigma:R -> Gamma(X,O_X) a ring homomorphism. For a short exact sequence S of O_X-modules and q >= 0, if H^q(X,S.X1) and H^q(X,S.X3) are finite R-modules under restriction along sigma, then so is H^q(X,S.X2).

proof.text: The cohomology sequence of S is exact in the middle. Restrict its scalar action along sigma; the image of the left map is finitely generated, and the image of the right map is a submodule of a finite module over the Noetherian R. Apply Submodule.fg_of_fg_map_of_fg_inf_ker to the top submodule. This is exactly the delivered Lean proof.

theorem finite_H_of_shortExact {X : Scheme.{u}} (R : Type v) [CommRing R]
    [IsNoetherianRing R] (σ : R →+* Γ(X, ⊤))
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact) (q : ℕ) :
    letI : Module R (S.X₁.H q) := Module.compHom _ σ
    letI : Module R (S.X₂.H q) := Module.compHom _ σ
    letI : Module R (S.X₃.H q) := Module.compHom _ σ
    Module.Finite R (S.X₁.H q) → Module.Finite R (S.X₃.H q) →
      Module.Finite R (S.X₂.H q)
